user_request: Automatically re-present a failed calibration point until it passes, preserving other points.

behavior.cancellation: Esc checked in each sampling/presentation loop
behavior.retries: Insufficient fresh frames, unstable eye/head measurements or a specific failed final check repeat only that target.
behavior.replacement: Newest complete accepted target exposure replaces the failed exposure; no maximum angle or best sample selection.
behavior.safety: Distinct presentation tokens and fresh capture timestamps; original head reference fixed across centre-eye retries.
behavior.memory: At most nine target windows and bounded per-point counters; frame digest set reset for each exposure.
behavior.diagnostics: Five compact local session reports, aggregate retry counts and latest failure per target.
behavior.global_failure: Collapsed angular span, contradictory geometry, degenerate transform or inconsistent affine fit stop with a specific explanation; these do not reliably identify one causal bad point.
behavior.statistical_scope: Repeated personal setup checks are adaptive, not an independent accuracy evaluation. Four check targets never enter the fit formula.

validation.physical_acceptance: Pending user webcam check; synthetic calibration and packaging checks do not establish webcam accuracy.

distribution: Private closed noncommercial hackathon prototype; source and license notices included; no public deploy.

publication_redaction.embedded_evidence_hashes_scope: historical original artifacts; a redacted report copy has a different file hash
